title: Three Weeks and One Short Scale
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（人与自我·做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（人与自我·做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：loss　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 loss 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the keeper ① bore the loss that no trader in the market would have recorded, and he said the bearing was the whole of the week. The ② loss, meaning the deficit itself and not the scale, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a loss, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ loss in that market had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ loss at the far stall, meaning the debt they kept for the children to settle and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A loss, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the loss was the whole of the matter, meaning the setback and not the deficit. The ⑥ loss, meaning the setback and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; loss, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both a deficit and a setback. He said the setback is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ loss had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ loss of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one market and three weeks of recording; loss, he said, is either the debt at the far stall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ loss I remember is the deficit recorded in the account, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ loss, my mother said in 1988, is the only deficit that improves by being recorded; every loss, she said, is a setback that has agreed to look like a deficit. She said the setback was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 亏损；损失（指集市里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 亏损；损失（指那次亏损本身，与秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the loss 承受这一次亏损
D. n. 亏损；损失（指留给孩子们清的那一笔那一次）
E. n. 折本之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的亏损之事）
F. n. 亏损；损失（指账本里写到、被记载的的那一次）
G. n. 挫折、代价（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 代价（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the loss that no trader in the market would have recorded
The loss, meaning the deficit itself and not the scale
the loss at the far stall

The loss of the whole thing

answers.why: bear the loss 意为“承受这一次亏损”，1979 年那位掌柜把集市里没有一位商贩肯记载的一次亏损做了一遍。
loss 意为“亏损；损失”，指那次亏损本身而不是秤，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
loss 意为“亏损；损失”，指集市里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
loss 意为“亏损；损失”，指最远那个摊子留给孩子们清的那一笔那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
loss 意为“挫折、代价”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个挫折就是那件事的全部。
loss 意为“代价”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次亏损，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
loss 意为“亏损；损失”，指账本里写到、被记载的的那一次，到 1984 年这一次成了账本里的一行。
loss 意为“折本之事”，掌柜三月写道，整件事的亏损之事是一处集市和三个星期的记载。
loss 意为“亏损；损失”，我记得的是账本里记载过的那一次，1986 年记完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一次。
loss 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，亏损是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的亏损。
